actors.name: Nimbus Freight's bid team
actors.private_context: The team has prepared a tender for the Valdoria postal contract. They need to get the tender document signed by two required directors and submitted before Friday's 12:00 deadline. They know who the two directors are and have a process for obtaining signatures.

actors.name: Director 1
actors.private_context: One of the two directors whose signature is required on the Valdoria postal-contract tender. They are aware of the tender and the deadline but have not yet signed.

actors.name: Director 2
actors.private_context: One of the two directors whose signature is required on the Valdoria postal-contract tender. They are aware of the tender and the deadline but have not yet signed.

shared_context: Nimbus Freight is pursuing the Valdoria postal contract. The tender document requires signatures from two directors before submission. The submission deadline is Friday, 2026-08-28 at 12:00. The bid team can approach the directors for signatures. The directors may be available or unavailable, and may sign or not sign.

starting_events.description: The bid team begins work on obtaining the two required signatures for the Valdoria postal-contract tender.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that both required directors signed the tender document and the signed document was submitted before Friday 2026-08-28T12:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
